// A joint histogram of two variables over uniform bins. The column index of
// Counts selects the x bin, the row index selects the y bin; bin edges follow
// the same half-open convention as Histogram.
type Histogram2D
    implements IValue
{
    RangeX: NumberInterval;
    RangeY: NumberInterval;
    Counts: Array2D<Integer>;
}
